nodes.label: Server Can Be Plugin
nodes.rationale: IUserManager, ILibraryManager, IDtoService are in published Jellyfin.Controller; IScheduledTask is in Jellyfin.Model with auto-discovery; plugin controllers are auto-routed via mvcBuilder.AddApplicationPart. Therefore the server half can be a plugin rather than a fork.

nodes.label: UI Cannot Be Plugin
nodes.rationale: Exhaustive investigation of all extension vectors: plugin pages require admin-level ServerContentPage; no CustomJs counterpart to CustomCss exists; route table is built statically at import time; pluginManager relies on build-time webpack context; server only serves static files as-is. The tile page requires a jellyfin-web fork permanently.

nodes.label: Two-Step Studios Flow (TV)
nodes.rationale: A sample library of 56 films carries 209 studios. ByGenreFragment would fire 209 concurrent requests on open. Studios use ByStudioFragment (grid of studio cards) -> StudioItemsFragment instead, fetching on demand.

nodes.label: Seed-Once Preset Semantics
nodes.rationale: Presets are applied as defaults for fresh localStorage/preferences keys, not reapplied on every visit. This lets users adjust sort within a mode without it resetting, while keeping the plain library view undisturbed.

nodes.label: Owned Content Only
nodes.rationale: Trending and Top Rated only show titles already in the user's library. Showing unowned content would produce dead clicks; Jellyseerr already solves discovery-then-request properly.

nodes.label: No IMDb Top 250
nodes.rationale: IMDb has no free API and scraping breaks their terms. TMDB Top Rated was used instead for the Top Rated tile.

nodes.label: US TV Rating Prefix Stripping Bug
nodes.norm_label: us tv rating prefix stripping bug

nodes.label: CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies
nodes.rationale: A library build does not copy NuGet dependencies to output, but a plugin is loaded from a folder rather than through deps.json. Without this flag, only the plugin DLL is output and TMDbLib would be missing at runtime.

nodes.label: ExcludeAssets Runtime
nodes.rationale: With CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies enabled, Jellyfin packages would be copied into the plugin folder, and PluginManager loads every DLL into the plugin's own AssemblyLoadContext — producing duplicate type identities for server-provided types and failing casts.

nodes.label: User-Supplied TMDb Key Requirement
nodes.rationale: The server bundles a TMDb key in MediaBrowser.Providers which the plugin cannot reference. Users must supply their own free key in plugin settings.
